_doc: Published on-device measurements used to calibrate and validate the cost model. Stage times are ms/token from each firmware's own profile line. Do not edit a row to update it; add a new one.

runs.source: refs/esp32-ai/firmware/esp32_barista/README.md 'Measured': per forward 49.6 ms. mean_pos is an ASSUMPTION (short questions, ~32 pieces/answer); see validate.py sensitivity sweep
refs/esp32-tinyLLM/BENCHMARKING.md, 'Rust, --fast-mspi' row. Only PSRAM clock changes (flash part stays at its own clock)
runs.caveat: 2026-09-29: phase 1 (docs/phase1-bench.md) found that on the S3 the flash shares the MSPI clock and also runs at 120 MHz. If so here, the model (flash cost from the 80 MHz fit) over-prices flash, and the -4.6% agreement is partly errors cancelling
